source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: November belongs to fur trim and animal print: a November 2026 trends roundup spotlights matching fur-trimmed capes and skirts plus animal-print coats with fur trim — a fur scarf tied at the waist works as the no-buy version — while a New York fall-fashion segment (60K likes) shows a tiger-print faux-fur coat over a pink dress, a bold red power suit and cobalt blue, and a style-predictions carousel forecasts striped socks with ballet flats and vintage L.L.Bean fleeces.
trends.title: November fur trim and animal print — fur-trimmed coats, pencil mini skirts

trends.details: November 1 flips the house from fall to cozy holiday: one 11K-like reel swaps autumn styling for Christmas touches overnight, a fall decorating finale layers sequin runners, pampas grass, a lit fall tree and a plush pumpkin on the sofa, and a Thanksgiving table tour builds three looks on one small table — Classic Gold, Rich Burgundy and Modern Sage — around a fruit-and-flower centerpiece.
trends.title: The November decor flip and Thanksgiving tables — cozy holiday styling, gold/burgundy/sage

trends.details: Fall glam turns toasty: a 'Toasty Fall Girl Glam' routine builds a warm look with foundation, concealer, cream blush, warm brown eyeshadow and false lashes, a soft autumn routine pairs a liquid base with cream blush, powder bronzer and shimmery winged liner, and a fall lip-combo tutorial cycles through brown liner-and-gloss pairings, while an 8.2K-like autumn makeup tutorial layers pink cream blush with bronzer and false lashes.
trends.title: Toasty fall glam — warm brown eyes, cream blush, glossy brown lips
